counting_rule: Representations of the same intellectual work share one source_family_id and do not count as independent corroboration.

enumeration_audit.enumeration_rule: Every regular file recursively below docs/research/books is included; directory globs, inferred derivatives, and unobserved works are not counted.
enumeration_audit.conceptual_deduplication: Eight PDF/Markdown pairs are eight source lineages; Clean Architecture and A Philosophy of Software Design are two distinct PDF-only lineages.

authority.rule: The corpus informs original Ranex synthesis; it does not override accepted policy, standards, law, owner decisions, or runtime evidence.
